name: coffer-web
description: Coffer web UI per ADR-0007. Vite + React + TanStack stack.
//deps-rationale: @fontsource/inter + jetbrains-mono — the two UI fonts, bundled instead of loaded from Google Fonts (FU-091), which told a third party every time Coffer was opened.
@tanstack/react-query    — server state (cache + retries + suspense). One QueryClient per app.
@tanstack/react-router   — type-safe router; code-based routing (no codegen) for explicitness.
@tanstack/react-virtual  — row-windowing for the register (only renders visible rows).
react / react-dom        — pinned at 18.3.x: one major version behind 19 to stay on the most-trodden tier.
class-variance-authority — variants for our hand-built primitives (Button / Input / Card).
clsx + tailwind-merge    — utility class composition, the de-facto idiom in the Tailwind ecosystem.
lucide-react             — icon set (the same set shadcn uses).
tailwindcss + @tailwindcss/vite — v4, CSS-first config. The @theme block in src/index.css holds the design tokens (ADR-0021).
